acceptance.given: The Package B handoff table has been authored for migration-contract validation.

oracle.expected: The table contains an accepted quality-contract entry for each of the five Skills, including the accepted CLI contract, legacy behavior, expected migration touchpoints, preserved authority, and optional Bootstrap Review status.
forbidden: Any of the five Skills lacks an accepted quality-contract entry.
A Skill row omits its CLI contract, legacy behavior, or migration touchpoints.
The table makes Bootstrap Review mandatory or changes existing authority.
oracle.observable: Artifact-level validation parses the Package B handoff table and checks five Skill rows for the required accepted-contract and migration fields.

acceptance.then: The handoff table records complete accepted quality-contract and migration information for all five Skills while preserving authority and optional Bootstrap Review.
acceptance.when: During migration-contract validation before Package A completion is accepted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a25 against a handoff table with a missing Skill row or required contract field; validation must report the specific missing handoff content.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Create the Package B handoff table with accepted quality-contract, CLI, legacy-behavior, migration-touchpoint, authority, and optional Bootstrap Review entries for all five Skills.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation rollback restores or removes the handoff table; no runtime state or schema migration is affected.

slice_hint.state_transition: The handoff table transitions from absent or incomplete to complete accepted-contract coverage for all five Skills.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A25 migration test and whole-plan terminal validation parse the handoff table and verify all five Skills have required accepted-contract fields with Bootstrap Review still optional.
